summary: Sells thematic tech as 12+ single-theme certificates plus a UCITS umbrella, backed by research since 2004, a 1,300-sub-sector taxonomy and the Fundy AI/quant platform. Ungated pages show price, YTD and ISIN; the factsheet has monthly returns and fees. Closest Swiss peer on tech theme and hybrid method, but long-only and broad in tone.

A EUR 139m long-only multi-thematic growth UCITS now ~52% IT and ~35% AI infrastructure. Markets through PM interviews and multilingual corporate pages; the fund site is gated but full-performance factsheets are public. Tech is real exposure but not the brand.

The scale benchmark: Robotics EUR 13bn, Digital USD 4.3bn, each with a standardised data-dense page and full document library. Regulatory tone, no personal voices. TR-Atlas Titan (EUR 688m) is its discretionary L/S, not tech-specific.

A Zug startup (Jul 2026) running an AI-native market-neutral L/S built by ex-NBIM PMs. Brand-led one-pager that leads with founders and a 'human + machine' philosophy, with no fund data. The closest structural twin to TMS, without a track record.

Turns its data/AI edge into numbers (signals per day, petabytes, % of trades influenced) with a human-in-the-loop line, and publishes NAV, charts and factsheets openly. Strongest storytelling of the hybrid model; retail-heavy brand and net-long bias.
A mid-cap tech L/S distributed as a UCITS on UBP's Geneva platform. The platform page is data-only (full performance after the gate); the manager has no website of its own and does not post.

A USD 861m TMT L/S UCITS on the Schroder GAIA platform. Schroders publishes full returns and documents behind a Swiss qualified gate; Contour's own one-pager gives the thesis and ~15 team bios. Purely discretionary; silent on LinkedIn.
The leading US TMT L/S (~USD 10bn) with a bare holding website. Markets through allocator relationships and press (Institutional Investor), not its own channels.
Launched in 2020 as a disruptive-tech L/S UCITS; last data USD 10.6m (Mar 2021) and no longer listed on wellington.com, so it appears closed. Kept only as a category reference.

The only tech L/S with a behavioural-sentiment quant overlay in the set, but the gated page shows no ISIN, fees, AUM, performance, documents or team and does not state its two sleeves. Its only proof point is a 2023 'Managed Futures' award. Peers behind the same kind of Swiss gate (Schroders, UBP) show full performance.
